html:
When diets, gym memberships, and lifestyle changes fail to move the needle, many people begin to look at medical intervention as a viable path. However, a common misconception is that anyone can walk in and request a procedure. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we follow strict clinical protocols to ensure that every patient we treat is a medically fit candidate for a permanent transformation. If you are researching a weight loss surgery hospital in Ahmedabad, the first thing you need to understand is the BMI threshold.

Body Mass Index (BMI) is a simple calculation using your height and weight to determine if your weight poses a risk to your health. Because the Indian body type is more prone to metabolic issues like diabetes and heart disease at a lower weight compared to Western populations, the eligibility criteria we follow at Silver Touch Hospitals are specifically tuned for Asian patients.

The numbers: Are you a candidate?

We don’t just look at the scale; we look at how your weight is affecting your internal health. According to the established clinical guidelines used at Silver Touch Hospitals, the minimum BMI requirements generally fall into two categories:

  • BMI of 37.5 and above: If your BMI has crossed this mark, you are eligible for bariatric surgery even if you do not currently have other health issues like high blood pressure. At this stage, the surgery is considered a preventive measure to avoid future complications.
  • BMI of 32.5 and above with co-morbidities: If you have a BMI over 32.5 and are struggling with obesity-related conditions, such as Type 2 Diabetes, sleep apnea, or severe joint pain, you are a candidate. In these cases, choosing a specialized weight loss surgery hospital in Ahmedabad is crucial because the surgery is used as a medical tool to potentially reverse these conditions.

Essential Pre-surgical Precautions

Meeting the BMI requirement is just the first step. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we ensure your safety through several mandatory precautions:

  • Medical screening: We conduct a full sweep of your heart and lung health to ensure you can safely undergo anesthesia.
  • Psychological readiness: Our team talks to you to ensure you are ready for the permanent lifestyle and dietary changes that follow the surgery.
  • Nutritional counseling: You will work with our in-house dieticians to understand how your relationship with food will evolve post-operation.

While these numbers provide a general guide, every body is unique. At Silver Touch Hospitals, we treat the person, not just the BMI. If you are tired of the cycle of weight gain and want to see if you qualify for a medical solution, we invite you to our clinic for a private assessment. Let’s work together to find the safest way for you to reclaim your health.
